title: Charged-Off Settlement Plan Term and the Borrower's Other Active Personal Loan
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a borrower whose other active Larkspur personal loan has an amount past due and a next due date at least 30 calendar days before the day the term is recorded loses 2 installments; a borrower whose other active loan has an amount past due and a next due date fewer than 30 calendar days earlier loses 1 installment; a borrower with no other active loan past due loses none, the borrower's other active loan being a single loan, because Larkspur lets a borrower hold at most two open personal loans at a time and takes no new loan application while any of the borrower's loans is charged off. The amount past due and the next due date are those on the borrower's active Personal Loans record.

| Other active Personal Loans loan | Installments lost |
|---|---|
| amount past due, next due date 30 or more calendar days before the day the term is recorded | 2 |
| amount past due, next due date fewer than 30 calendar days before that day | 1 |
| no amount past due, or no other active loan | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, term recorded on 31 May)

- Other loan past due with next due date 1 May: 30 calendar days earlier, 2 installments lost.
- Other loan past due with next due date 2 May: 29 days earlier, 1 installment lost.
- Other loan active with no amount past due: none lost.
